description: Search live real-world airline fares into Harry Reid International (LAS) from any 3-letter IATA origin airport with ULCC overhead carry-on fee math ($55-$65/way on Spirit/Frontier/Allegiant), Terminal 1 vs Terminal 3 rideshare garage floors, and fixed Nevada Taxicab Authority Strip zone fares ($22/$26/$30).

departure_date.description: Optional ISO departure date YYYY-MM-DD or month YYYY-MM

direct_only.description: Filter to nonstop flights only (default: false)

include_carry_on.description: Include overhead carry-on bag fee in true roundtrip total (default: true)

name: search_flights_to_las
